name: OpenELIS Global
description: Laboratory information system (LIS/LIMS) for clinical, public health, environmental and vector surveillance labs. FHIR-native, with analyzer integration (ASTM/HL7), quality control and national-scale reporting. ([Demo](https://openelis-global.org/getting-started/demo/), [Source Code](https://github.com/DIGI-UW/OpenELIS-Global-2)) `MPL-2.0` `Java/Docker`
